search.query: `sysmon` sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | stats count by EventDescription
`sysmon` EventCode=3 sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | top limit=20 sysmon_dest_host | rename sysmon_dest_host AS "Destination"
`sysmon` EventCode=3 sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | top limit=20 sysmon_dest_port | rename sysmon_dest_port AS "Destination Port"

`sysmon` EventCode=1 (sysmon_process_name="powershell.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="msbuild.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="psexec.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="at.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="schtasks.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="net.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="vssadmin.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="utilman.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="wmic.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="mshta.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="wscript.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="cscript.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="cmd.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="whoami.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="mmc.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="systeminfo.exe" OR sysmon_process_name="csvde.exe") sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | stats count by sysmon_process_name | rename sysmon_process_name AS Process
`sysmon` EventCode=1 sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | stats values(ParentImage) by sysmon_process_name | rename sysmon_process_name AS Process
`sysmon` EventCode=3 sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | stats values(sysmon_dest_host) AS Destinations by sysmon_process_path | rename sysmon_process_path AS Image
`sysmon` EventCode=1 MD5=* sysmon_computer=$comp|s$ sysmon_user=$usr|s$ | stats dc(MD5) as numhashes, values(MD5) AS "MD5 Hash" by sysmon_process_path | rename sysmon_process_path AS Image
